content.text:
=== re-run install.sh (should detect installed)
Diese Qisutu-Instanz ist bereits vollständig installiert.
Für ein Update entpacke das neue Qisutu-Release in ein separates Verzeichnis und führe dort aus:
  sudo ./update.sh /opt/qisutu
rc=1
=== apache configtest
AH00558: apache2: Could not reliably determine the server's fully qualified domain name, using 192.168.127.2. Set the 'ServerName' directive globally to suppress this message
Syntax OK
=== site symlink
lrwxrwxrwx 1 root root 30 Oct  4 21:03 /etc/apache2/sites-enabled/qisutu.conf -> ../sites-available/qisutu.conf
=== version
# the Free Software Foundation, either version 3 of the License, or
# (at your option) any later version.
version=2.0.2
minimum_program_version=1.0.1
database_version=2.0.2

observation.command:
echo "=== re-run install.sh (should detect installed)"; cd /opt/qisutu && QISUTU_INSTALL_LANGUAGE=de bash ./install.sh 2>&1 | tail -6; echo "rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
echo "=== apache configtest"; apache2ctl configtest 2>&1
echo "=== site symlink"; ls -l /etc/apache2/sites-enabled/qisutu.conf
echo "=== version"; grep -E "version|database_version" /opt/qisutu/release.conf
